title: Law to create resources and feedback channels for doulas
summary: This bill would require the Health Commissioner to publish a 'Doula Bill of Rights' explaining relevant laws within six months, and to create a form for doulas to submit feedback on their hospital experiences. It would also establish a doula advisory council, including doulas, recent parents and a Health + Hospitals representative, to study doula services and advise the Citywide Doula Program. The council would meet at least quarterly and appointments would be made within 90 days of the law taking effect.
